title: Adversarial Calibration Attack on Autonomous Vehicles
abstract: arXiv:2608.28778v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) rely on accurate camera-LiDAR calibration for multimodal sensor fusion. In practice, calibration can drift due to vibration, temperature variation, or minor sensor displacement, motivating online calibration algorithms that detect and correct misalignment at runtime while allowing the vehicle to continue operating without a factory visit. Existing AV attacks largely assume correct calibration. We instead identify online sensor calibration as a new attack plane. A corrupted calibration update can persist across subsequent fusion operations, causing system-wide errors that propagate from perception to planning and control. We present Adversarial Calibration Attack (ACA), the first physical attack against camera-LiDAR online calibration. translated_title: 针对自动驾驶车辆的对抗性标定攻击
translated_abstract: 自动驾驶车辆（AV）依赖精确的相机-激光雷达（LiDAR）标定来实现多模态传感器融合。在实际应用中，标定可能因振动、温度变化或传感器轻微位移而发生漂移，这催生了在线标定算法——此类算法能够在运行时检测并纠正错位，同时让车辆无需返厂即可继续运行。现有的自动驾驶攻击研究大多假设标定是正确的。我们则将在线传感器标定识别为一个全新的攻击面。被破坏的标定更新可以在后续的融合操作中持续存在，导致系统级错误从感知传播到规划与控制。我们提出了对抗性标定攻击，这是首个针对相机-激光雷达在线标定的物理攻击。仅需一张对抗性海报，ACA首先欺骗错位检测器以触发标定过程，然后将标定估计器引导至错误的变换参数。
tldr: 本文提出了首个针对自动驾驶车辆相机-激光雷达在线标定的物理攻击ACA，仅凭一张对抗性海报即可欺骗错位检测器并误导标定估计器产生错误变换参数，从而使错误从感知传播到规划与控制，造成系统级故障。
en_tdlr: This paper presents ACA, the first physical attack against camera-LiDAR online calibration in autonomous vehicles, which uses a single adversarial poster to spoof the miscalibration detector and steer the calibration estimator toward incorrect transformation parameters, propagating system-wide errors from perception to planning and control.
